_comment: ComfyUI API-format prompt (POST to /prompt). Tree detail-add img2img graph. Component E (the harness) deep-clones this, string-replaces the __TOKENS__, then POSTs it. RGB-only: the source 1-bit alpha is NOT carried through the model; the re-pixelation tail (magick) re-applies the source alpha. Tokens: __INPUT_IMAGE__ (filename already uploaded to ComfyUI /input), __POSITIVE__, __DENOISE__ (e.g. 0.40), __TILE_STRENGTH__ (ControlNet-Tile strength, e.g. 0.6), __SEED__ (integer).

_meta.title: Load RealESRGAN x4plus anime 6B ESRGAN model (BSD-3, commercial-OK)
ESRGAN 4x (192->768 / 256->1024) — clean structural upscale BEFORE the model
Normalize longest side to ~1024 so SDXL works at its native band
Pixel Art XL LoRA (forces blocky pixel-art detail)

inputs.text: blurry, smooth shading, anti-aliasing, gradient, photo, 3d render

_meta.title: ControlNet-Tile SDXL (locks composition to the source so detail is added, not invented)
Apply tile ControlNet using the upscaled image as the control hint
Encode the upscaled image to latent (img2img start)
img2img refine — low denoise keeps the silhouette, adds bark/leaf detail
Save detailed RGB (harness pulls this, then runs the magick re-pixelation tail)
